items.title: ARC-005 precision-only decoupled ladder, CALIBRATED: does the dACC goal-readout channel route precision once dacc_goal_readout_weight/normalize are actually set? (successor to V3-EXQ-848)
items.note: Bug-fix/calibration lettered successor to V3-EXQ-848 (ARC-005 precision-only decoupled ladder, FAIL/mixed 4/10 units, rho up to 0.866). 848's _agent_kwargs() never set dacc_goal_readout_weight, so it silently defaulted to 0.0 and the SD-057 L7 dACC goal-readout term (ree_core/cingulate/dacc.py DACCtoE3Adapter.forward(), gated on grw!=0.0) contributed EXACTLY ZERO to score_bias throughout 848's run -- the channel-1 dACC-consume pathway 848 was designed to test was never engaged; 848's observed signal is attributable to channel 1's pre-existing serotonin pathway and channel 2, not the dACC-consume mechanism. A follow-up direct probe (session IGW-20260801-199 / arc005_dacc_adapter_goal_proximity_training, instrumenting REEAgent.select_action on 848's own driver config) found this gap plus a units/calibration mismatch in raw candidate_goal_proximity (small achieved cross-candidate spread ~0.003-0.03 vs full [0,1] nominal range, because GoalState.goal_proximity()'s MSE-sum distance is dominated by the larger e2_world_forward candidate-summary norm rather than genuine goal-relative displacement -- a calibration issue, not an untrained consumer; DACCtoE3Adapter has no nn.Parameter anywhere). Both fixed on ree-v3 main commit 4b79d18d44 (SD-057 L7 amend): DACCConfig.dacc_goal_readout_normalize (new, default False, bit-identical off) does a per-candidate-set min-max rescale before the existing dacc_goal_readout_weight multiply. This successor sets dacc_goal_readout_weight=0.5 (V3-EXQ-637 precedent value) and dacc_goal_readout_normalize=True; every other design element (channel-1/2-only ladder, channels 3/4 fixed at L0, content sets, arena, schedule, seeds, the pre-registered C_PRECISION_MONOTONICITY criterion and its thresholds) is UNCHANGED from 848. Adds a build-time guard (asserts cfg.dacc_goal_readout_weight/normalize threaded through REEConfig.from_dims correctly, and agent.dacc_adapter.config carries them) plus a whole-run engagement check (agent.dacc_adapter._n_bias_calls must increment at least once across the run) specifically to prevent a repeat of 848's silent-zero failure mode. Substrate readiness: SD-057 IMPLEMENTED (ree-v3/CLAUDE.md); the L7 wiring fix is on main. Re-derive brake checked: 0 substrate_ceiling autopsies tag ARC-005 -- not braked. GOV-REUSE-1: the decisive readout (precision monotonicity with the calibrated dACC goal-readout channel genuinely engaged) does not exist in any recorded manifest -- 848's manifest ran with the channel silently inert, not a compatible substrate_hash for this question; not recoverable by reanalysis. supersedes: V3-EXQ-848 per the EXQ lettering convention's bug-fix rule, though 848's manifest evidence is not discarded -- see the script's SUPERSEDES_NOTE for why governance review should read both results together rather than treat 848 as invalidated outright. Smoke --dry-run PASS (12 cells at dry scale): all verdicts PASS, z_goal_stream active_frac=0.130 writer_calls=600 -- no writer defect, build-time guards held, total_dacc_bias_calls=492 (engagement check passed), result at dry scale is a near-zero null (all_near_zero_null=true) -- not scored at dry scale, informative only that the pipeline runs end-to-end without error. validate_experiments.py --strict: 0 findings across all checks.

Same design, same criterion as 848 otherwise.

items.title: SD-076 diagnostic REDESIGN: wci_symmetric_rv_ref/rv within-episode trajectory crossover, decoupled from CausalGridWorld's own episode termination (corrects V3-EXQ-864)
items.note: REDESIGN of V3-EXQ-864, per its own confirmed autopsy (failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-864_2026-08-01.md/.json). 864's sweep of STEPS_PER_EP in {200,500,1000} was inert: CausalGridWorld's own episode termination (agent_health<=0.0 or steps>=500, causal_grid_world.py:2892) fired at ~8-11 ticks/episode in this driver's env config, so diff_final and all end-of-episode readouts were bit-identical across all three swept values in both arms/seeds -- the sweep never varied real exposure. DESIGN FIX (full reasoning in the script's module docstring): the per-episode inner loop no longer breaks on env-reported done=True. Verified safe by direct source read: CausalGridWorld.step() computes done fresh every call with no special-casing of post-death ticks; harm_signal (the per-tick PE-generating signal both the inflated and counterfactual EMAs consume via update_residue->e3.post_action_update) is computed identically whether or not agent_health has already floored; neither REEAgent nor StepHarness gates on agent_health; agent_health recovers via ordinary resource contact same as pre-death; the internal steps>=500 cap's only other effect (body[9] observation feature saturating at 1.0) is bounded and harmless. This realizes both of the autopsy's own suggested repairs (disable agent-death termination + raise/ignore the internal step cap) through one mechanism, with the SAME hazard dynamics and SAME agent (no extra pretraining, no reduced-hazard env, no env-reset concatenation) -- three alternative repair strategies (train the agent to survive; reduce/remove hazards for this diagnostic; concatenate short env sub-episodes) were each considered and rejected in the docstring because each would confound the very EMA dynamics under measurement (either by changing the trained policy, changing the PE-stream's character, or by desynchronizing agent.reset()'s once-per-episode recalibration cadence from real exposure / injecting teleport-artifact PE spikes). New precondition real_exposure_achieved (floor 0.999) operationalizes the fix as a measured, falsifiable check per cell, plus an in-code regression assert that final_global_tick_reached varies across swept STEPS_PER_EP values (would catch a reintroduced early-break defect before a multi-hour run). Smoke test (--dry-run, reduced steps_sweep=(20,40), 8 cells) 2026-08-02: all 8 verdict:PASS, real_exposure_frac=1.0000 in every cell (final_global_tick=59 for steps20 cells = 20*3-1 exactly; =119 for steps40 cells = 40*3-1 exactly), env_done_ticks 34-102 of 60-120 confirming the environment's own termination DID fire repeatedly (consistent with 864's diagnosed ~8-11-tick early death) while the redesigned driver correctly ran through it. validate_experiments.py --strict: 0 non-conforming, 0 warnings of any kind. Real cost realizes 864's own originally-stated (but never actually paid) budget: (200+500+1000)*8*2*2=54400 train-only ticks, ~30% of 860's 180000, projected ~21min of pure step time from 860's measured 0.0233 s/step (860 elapsed_seconds=4200.6 for 180000 steps) plus init/optimizer overhead -- estimated_minutes=45 accordingly (864's own pre-registered 40min estimate, +5min buffer since this run now actually executes the full budget). Does NOT block EVB-0454 (SD-076 decision proceeds on V3-EXQ-860 Finding A, untouched by this diagnostic). Re-derive brake (Step 2.5b): 864's own autopsy category is measurement_test_design_defect/action:none (instrument repair, not a substrate gap) -- does not count toward SD-076's brake tally per the INSTRUMENT carve-out; 0 prior substrate_ceiling autopsies for SD-076. GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): checked via reanalysis_query.py query --readout rv_trajectory_within_episode --claim SD-076 (2026-08-02) against 794/794a/850-h1/850-h2/860/864 -- 0 carry a within-episode trajectory readout at verified-varying exposure (864's own trajectory data is defective, cannot answer the question). Not recoverable -> run. items.title: MECH-480: dACC-analog execution-gain dissociation -- outcome-sensitivity vs logit-margin execution strength under dacc_weight OFF/ON ablation with mid-episode contingency switch (EXP-0413)
items.note: Authored via /queue-experiment for claim MECH-480 (registered 2026-08-02) using fully-drafted proposal EXP-0413 in REE_assembly/evidence/planning/manual_proposals.v1.json. Claim: SD-032b's dACC-analog output may conflate strategy authority (already covered by SD-032b/MECH-258/MECH-260) with a separable LOFC-analog execution-gain channel (how strongly a persisting policy is expressed). Source paper found via targeted search (raw thought intake cited it only as 'a recent Nature Communications paper'): Asaoka N., Pagano D., Hayashi Y. 'Dissociable roles of prefrontal plasticity in decision making strategy and execution of habitual behavior.' Nature Communications (2026). DOI 10.1038/s41467-026-75706-1 (Kyoto University; bioRxiv 10.1101/2025.05.19.654900). Design: 2-arm ablation on the existing dacc_weight config flag (OFF: dacc_weight=0/use_dacc=False; ON: dacc_weight=3.0/use_dacc=True, gain carried from v3_exq_450's calibration) -- no new dACC/OFC substrate. Contingency-switch mechanism (the proposal's sanctioned 'smallest addition', no ree_core edits): each P2 episode confines resources to the grid's left quarter, then geometrically mirrors them to the right quarter mid-episode via direct env.resources relocation + the env's own _compute_proximity_fields() rebuild (reused, not reimplemented) -- the same 'mutate env attributes at a phase boundary' convention already used by v3_exq_655. DVs read off the existing, unmodified E3 selector: (i) outcome-sensitivity = fraction of post-switch ticks whose realized agent_x displacement moves toward the new resource region; (ii) execution strength = logit margin (second-lowest minus lowest of agent.e3.last_scores) at genuine E3 ticks only -- last_scores is explicitly cleared before every select_action() call and skipped (counted in n_latched_ticks) when still None afterward, per the sample-size-integrity convention (E3 cadence default 10 env-steps; a naive per-tick read would pseudo-replicate ~10x). NON-DEGENERACY precondition (EXP-0413 acceptance check 3, checked first): Arm-OFF execution-strength must show non-zero cross-seed spread (via _metrics.check_degeneracy, eps=MARGIN_VARIANCE_FLOOR=1e-4) or the run self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue rather than any verdict. PASS/supports requires BOTH C1 (ON-OFF outcome-sensitivity delta >= 0.15 on >=2/3 seeds) AND C2 (|ON-OFF| execution-strength <= 0.05 on >=2/3 seeds); FAIL/weakens otherwise (folds back into SD-032b's single-channel account). claim_ids=['MECH-480'] only -- SD-032b/MECH-258/MECH-260 are the ablated substrate and prior lineage this claim reframes, cited as related_claims but not scored (a PASS/FAIL here is not new evidence for their own already-covered content). GOV-REUSE-1: no recorded manifest compares outcome-sensitivity against execution-strength under a dacc OFF/ON ablation with a mid-episode contingency switch -- not recoverable, proceeds to a fresh run. Re-derive brake (2.5b): 0 failure_autopsy artifacts tag MECH-480 (brand-new claim) -- not braked. Deliberately does NOT reuse a P0 encoder-warmup phase: the direct precedent for this lineage (v3_exq_450) runs its entire pre-eval budget as plain env-stepping + E2_harm_a training only, with no external E1/E2-world-forward optimizer; matching that (rather than importing an unvalidated extra phase from a different OFC-devaluation script) also fixed a real bug caught during authoring (a copied E1-training block that never called agent.record_transition, so its own buffer would never have filled). Code review (Step 3.5) + validate_experiments.py --strict: 0 findings (0 non-conforming, 0 warnings of any kind after adding an explicit direction:'lower' tag to the non-degeneracy precondition). Smoke test (--dry-run, 1 seed x 2 conditions, tiny P1=4/P2=2/steps=20/switch=10): both conditions ran cleanly, n_genuine_selections>0 asserted and confirmed in both arms (dACC OFF/ON config, harm_a stream gated correctly, resource relocation confirmed in both regions), z_goal_stream wired (writer_calls=12546, not a writer defect), manifest correctly written then relocated out of evidence/experiments/ by emit_outcome(dry_run=True). At this tiny scale the run legitimately self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue (a single seed cannot show cross-seed variance) -- expected and correct, not a finding.

items.title: ARC-062/MECH-309 full-budget replication of V3-EXQ-859: lateral_pfc route_source vs none ablation, MECH-448/449 engagement (~7.7h)
items.note: ARC-062/MECH-309 FULL-TRAINING-BUDGET replication of V3-EXQ-859's lateral_pfc-vs-none route_source ablation (failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-859_2026-08-01.md, user-confirmed routing: "chip the full-training-budget (~7.7h) replication now ... rather than deferring the compute-cost judgment call to /governance"). BACKGROUND: V3-EXQ-851 (full ~7.7h, P0=200/P1=90/P2=60, seeds 42/43/44) found MECH-448 (F-eligibility demotion) completely dead (0.0) under modulatory_channel_route_source='lateral_pfc', vs robustly live (17.76) under 'cand_world_summary' in matched-stack template V3-EXQ-654j (same seeds). V3-EXQ-859 (cheap ~45min diagnostic, P0=10/P2=10, no P1) compared 'lateral_pfc' vs 'none' at the same seeds to isolate whether route_source itself is causal: MECH-448 was ALIVE in BOTH arms (3/3 seeds each) -- did NOT reproduce 851's collapse under either value. MECH-449 was dead in BOTH arms, matching its deadness in 851. Two readings remained undistinguished: (a) route_source has no causal effect on MECH-448 at all -- 851's diagnosis needs a different explanation; or (b) route_source's effect is training-duration-dependent and only emerges over a longer run, which 859's 45-minute probe cannot detect by construction. THIS RUN: same 2-arm ablation (modulatory_channel_route_source='lateral_pfc' vs 'none'), same seeds (42/43/44), same matched-stack config as V3-EXQ-859 (use_candidate_rule_field=True fixed on both arms, USE_F_ELIGIBILITY_DEMOTION/USE_GO_NOGO_CONSTITUTION/USE_DACC/USE_MODULATORY_SELECTION_AUTHORITY/USE_MODULATORY_CHANNEL_ROUTING all matched, identical ENV_KWARGS, identical CRF maturity levers, identical SD-056 online e2 training) but extended to FULL budget matching V3-EXQ-851's own schedule exactly: P0=200/P1=90/P2=60 (350 episodes/cell x 200 steps x 3 seeds x 2 arms = 420000 ticks, ~7.67h on the cloud fleet per 851's own measured elapsed_seconds=27623). P1 (bias-head REINFORCE training) is reused verbatim from V3-EXQ-851's own machinery -- 859 skipped P1 as out-of-scope for its structural-engagement question, but running it here reproduces 851's training schedule structurally, not just numerically, and does not privilege either arm since agent.lateral_pfc exists and trains on BOTH arms regardless of route_source. Primary readout is UNCHANGED from V3-EXQ-859 (NOT a rebuild of V3-EXQ-851's full C1(a-g) readiness gate + C2 committed-class-entropy falsifier apparatus): MECH-448 (f_eligibility_demotion_active_frac + mean f_eligibility_excluded_count) and MECH-449 (go_nogo_active_frac + mean safety+soft suppressions) engagement, latch-cleared on every P2 tick. claim_ids=[] (matches V3-EXQ-859's own convention -- routing diagnostic, not new MECH-309/ARC-062 evidence); experiment_purpose='diagnostic'; supersedes=null (does NOT supersede V3-EXQ-859 -- 859's short-budget result stands on its own terms as a correctly-self-routed 'needs_full_replication' finding, this is a duration-extended follow-up, not a bug-fix correction). COMPUTE COST -- FLAGGED EXPLICITLY, deliberate user judgment call (2026-08-01, chip-20260801-859-full-replication): this is a real ~7.7-HOUR compute commitment. Accepted because V3-EXQ-858 (ARC-062 GOV-FANOUT-1 Leg P-B, a 1200-minute/20-hour 4-rung f_weight attenuation ladder run) is ALREADY sitting suspended pending exactly this question -- the cost of running this once is smaller than leaving that allocation suspended indefinitely on an ambiguous short-probe result. THIS RESULT DETERMINES WHETHER V3-EXQ-858 CAN BE UNBLOCKED: V3-EXQ-858's own matched-stack config presupposes MECH-448/449 are active under lateral_pfc routing, which is exactly what is in question here. NOTE (observed at queue time, 2026-08-01): the current experiment_queue.json snapshot shows V3-EXQ-858 status='claimed' on ree-cloud-4 since 2026-08-01T12:44:33Z, not 'suspended' -- a coordinator-side hold/suspend action may not be reflected in this git-derived queue view (holds are coordinator-side per CLAUDE.md 'Phase-3 queue lever depends on op'); flagged for the user/governance to reconcile, not resolved by this queue entry. items.title: MECH-090/ARC-071: commit-latch cross-tick persistence post-fix validation under organic chunk formation (GOV-FANOUT-1 follow-on to V3-EXQ-841, ree-v3 main 278599a)
items.note:
Post-fix validation of MECH-090/ARC-071 commit-latch cross-tick persistence. Origin: failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-841_2026-07-31's GOV-FANOUT-1 fanout_recommendation (H1 wiring vs H2 readout-artifact discrimination probe on Finding B -- realised committed-chunk length pinned at exactly 1 step in 100% of 32 chunking cells, independent of chunk_max_size). Script was drafted+smoke-tested 2026-08-01 but DELIBERATELY HELD unqueued (WORKSPACE_STATE.md 2026-08-01T00:27:23Z) because a parallel session's ad hoc (non-EXQ) probe -- diagnostic_arc071_commit_latch_h1h2_probe_2026-07-31.md -- had already resolved H1/H2 directly: H1 (real ree_core wiring defect) CONFIRMED, H2 (readout artifact) REFUTED (official read path verified to faithfully report ground truth, 0/160 mismatches). Trigger to queue was explicit: 'once the agent.py fallback fix lands and merges to ree-v3 main.' VERIFIED landed: commit 278599a (2026-08-01T01:26:43+01:00), ancestor of origin/main, adds a fallback to agent.e3._persistent_committed_trajectory in agent.py's between-E3-tick stepping branch, gated behind a new flag use_persistent_committed_program_handle (default False). This fixes ONE of two independent wiring gaps the diagnosis found; the second (E3 unconditionally re-committing a brand-new trajectory object every E3 tick regardless of an existing unexpired commitment) remains open and unfixed.

CODE REVIEW (this session, since the script predates its normal /queue-experiment pass): (1) CRITICAL -- _arm_flags() did not set use_persistent_committed_program_handle=True, so running as-drafted would only reproduce the already-known pre-fix result under organic formation, exactly the outcome the hold-note warned against. Fixed: added the flag as a script-local override (mirrors the existing precedent at experiments/_lib/baselines/sd084_midexec_reachability.py:271; does not touch the shared arc071_chunking.py baseline, since lineage-wide enablement is a separate governance-aware decision on arm-reuse fingerprint blast radius per the diagnosis doc). This changes the run's question from 're-litigate resolved H1/H2' to 'does the landed fix restore persistence under REAL organic chunk formation, informing whether lineage-wide enablement is warranted'. (2) The script's own H1/H2 verdict-discrimination logic (mean_true_dwell_ticks vs frac_between_tick_frozen) conflates two independent substrate mechanisms -- the SD-084 persistent-handle's object-identity survival vs the separate _committed_step_idx counter's advance -- and would have misclassified the ad hoc probe's own confirmed-H1 finding (true dwell high + idx frozen) as h2_readout_artifact_dominant. Fixed: replaced with a direct verdict routed on official_readout_mean_realised_length (the SAME statistic 841 itself used to establish 'pinned at 1'), labels renamed persistence_restored_post_fix / persistence_still_broken_post_fix; old identity-based stats retained as supplementary diagnostics only. (3) write_flat_manifest() call was missing agent=/z_goal_stream_stats= (skill Step 3.5 output-contract requirement for any driver that steps an agent) -- fixed via ZGoalStreamAccumulator (fresh agent per seed cell), confirmed wired in smoke test (writer_calls=551, no writer defect).

ID CONFLICT: the script's own placeholder V3-EXQ-855 was NEVER queued or committed (git log --all -S"V3-EXQ-855" empty across ree-v3) and is stale per the hold-note's own prediction; queue max at write time was V3-EXQ-870 (re-verified after git pull origin main --ff-only immediately before append) -- assigned V3-EXQ-871.
